AI Study Companion for WAEC / NECO / JAMB

1. PRODUCT OVERVIEW
Product Name (Working): ExamAce AI / PassExam AI (WAEC • NECO • JAMB)
Goal:
Provide a single AI-powered study companion that helps Nigerian students prepare effectively for WAEC, NECO, and JAMB, combining teaching, practice, revision, and exam strategy.
Target Users:
• SS2 & SS3 students (WAEC / NECO)
• JAMB candidates (UTME)
Platform:
• Progressive Web App (PWA)
• Installable on Android & iOS
• Optimized for low-end devices and low data usage
2. FULL FEATURE LIST (PHASE 1 – MVP)
2.1 User Account & Smart Onboarding
Features:
• Sign up (Email / Phone number)
• Select exam type(s): WAEC / NECO / JAMB
• Select subjects (based on exam type)
• Set exam date(s)
• Choose weak subjects
Exam-Based Subject Rules:
• WAEC/NECO: Maths, English, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, others later
• JAMB: English (compulsory) + 3 chosen subjects
Outcome:
Highly personalized learning path per exam.
2.2 Unified Dashboard (Student Home)
What the student sees:
• Greeting + student name
• Exam countdown(s)
• Today’s AI-generated study plan
• Progress summary per exam & subject
Quick Actions:
• Ask AI Tutor
• Continue Learning
• Practice Questions
• Take Mock Test
2.3 AI Tutor (Core Feature)
Description:
A chat-based AI teacher that adapts its teaching style based on the selected exam (WAEC/NECO vs JAMB).
Capabilities:
• Explain topics at the right exam depth
• Solve problems step-by-step
• Provide exam-specific tips
• Highlight common traps
Teaching Mode Differences:
• WAEC/NECO: Detailed explanations, theory focus, marking points
• JAMB: Speed, accuracy, shortcuts, elimination methods
Standard AI Response Structure:
• Definition / Key idea
• Simple explanation
• Worked example
• Exam tip (WAEC or JAMB specific)
• Common mistake
2.4 Subject Learning Module
Structure:
Exam → Subject → Topic → Subtopic
Each topic includes:
• Clear explanation
• Examples (exam-specific)
• Key formulas / points
• Summary box
Subjects (Initial):
• English Language
• Mathematics
• Biology
• Chemistry
• Physics
2.5 Past Questions & Question Bank
Separated by Exam Type:
WAEC / NECO:
• Objective (OBJ)
• Theory (ESSAY)
• Practical explanations
JAMB:
• UTME CBT-style questions
• Topic-based and year-based
Features:
• Filter by year
• Filter by topic
• AI explanation for every question
2.6 Essay & Theory Answer Coach (WAEC / NECO)
How it works:
• Student writes answer
• AI scores it using WAEC/NECO marking scheme
• Highlights missing points
• Provides model answer
Covers:
• English essays
• Science theory questions
2.7 JAMB CBT Practice & Speed Trainer
Features:
• Timed CBT practice tests
• Question navigation like real UTME
• Countdown timer
AI Feedback:
• Speed vs accuracy analysis
• Weak topics
• Score prediction
2.8 Smart Study & Revision Planner
Inputs:
• Exam(s)
• Subjects
• Exam dates
• Weak areas
Outputs:
• Daily study schedule
• Weekly revision goals
• Dedicated JAMB speed-practice days
2.9 Practice Tests & Mini Quizzes
Types:
• Topic quizzes
• Subject tests
• Full exam simulations
Instant Feedback:
• Score
• Correct answers
• AI improvement tips
2.10 Progress Tracking & Analytics
Shows:
• Exam readiness score (WAEC / NECO / JAMB)
• Subject mastery level
• Accuracy & speed (for JAMB)
• Study consistency
2.11 Offline & Low-Data Mode
Features:
• Download lessons
• Cache questions & explanations
• Text-first interface

3. TEXT-BASED WIREFRAME (SCREEN BY SCREEN)
3.1 Welcome Screen
• App logo
• “Prepare for WAEC, NECO & JAMB with AI”
• Get Started
• Login
3.2 Onboarding Screen
• Select Exam(s)
• Select Subjects (dynamic)
• Set Exam Date(s)
• Continue
3.3 Dashboard Screen
• Greeting + exam countdown(s)
• Today’s study plan
• Progress snapshot
Bottom Navigation:
• Home
• Subjects
• AI Tutor
• Practice
• Profile
3.4 Subjects Screen
• Exam filter (WAEC / NECO / JAMB)
• Subject list with progress bars
3.5 Topic Detail Screen
• Topic title
• Explanation
• Examples
• Buttons:
• Ask AI
• Practice Questions
3.6 AI Tutor Screen
• Chat interface
• Exam mode indicator
• Input box
3.7 Questions Bank Screen
• Choose Exam
• Choose Subject
• Choose Year / Topic
3.8 Essay Practice Screen (WAEC/NECO)
• Question
• Answer input
• Submit
Result:
• Score
• Missing points
• Model answer
3.9 CBT Practice Screen (JAMB)
• Timer
• Question navigation
• Submit test
Result:
• Score
• Speed analysis
• AI tips
3.10 Progress Screen
• Exam readiness meters
• Weak topics
• Performance trends
3.11 Profile & Settings
• Personal info
• Exam preferences
• Subscription status
• Help & Support

**Conceptualizing AI Companion**

I'm currently fleshing out the core concept. The user's requirements for an AI-powered study companion are solidifying. I'm leaning towards "ExamAce AI" or "PassExam AI" as strong product names. The crucial exam types – WAEC, NECO, JAMB – are clearly in focus.


**Refining Core Features**

I'm now diving into the specifics of the application's functionality. I'm prioritizing the Study Plan, AI Tutor (tailored for WAEC/NECO theory and JAMB speed), and Subject Learning Module. Exam-specific past question banks, essay coaching, and a JAMB CBT simulator are also high on my list. Mobile-first design is the focus.


**Defining App Structure**

I've been mapping out the app's components, focusing on `TopicDetail.tsx` for content, `AITutor.tsx` for the chat interface, and `QuestionBank.tsx` for practice. I'm also planning `EssayCoach.tsx` for essay grading and `CBTPractice.tsx` for JAMB simulation. I'll integrate `ProgressTracker.tsx` for analytics, all tied together by `App.tsx` using a router. `@google/genai` with `gemini-3-flash-preview` is the preferred AI engine, complemented by Tailwind for responsiveness and local storage for basic user persistence. The subject module is shaping up, and I'm developing AI prompting strategies for the tutor and essay coach.

# Privacy Policy

**DEMO – SSCE Exam Tutor**

*Last updated: [Insert Date]*

---

## 1. Introduction

DEMO – SSCE Exam Tutor ("DEMO", "we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information of students, parents, and users who use our platform.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our website, mobile web app (PWA), and related services (collectively, the “Service”).

By using DEMO, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

---

## 2. Information We Collect

### 2.1 Personal Information

We may collect the following information when you create an account or use the Service:

* Full name
* Email address
* Phone number
* Exam type (WAEC, NECO, JAMB)
* Subjects selected

### 2.2 Student Learning Data

To provide personalized learning, we collect:

* Questions asked to the AI tutor
* Practice test results and scores
* Essay submissions and feedback
* Study progress and performance data

### 2.3 Device & Usage Information

We may automatically collect:

* Device type and browser
* IP address (used for security and analytics)
* Pages visited and time spent on the app

---

## 3. How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to:

* Provide and improve learning services
* Personalize study plans and AI responses
* Track learning progress
* Communicate important updates
* Maintain platform security
* Process subscriptions and payments

We **do not sell or rent** your personal data to third parties.

---

## 4. AI & Data Usage

* Questions and answers may be processed by AI systems to generate responses.
* AI interactions are used only to improve learning experience and system quality.
* We do **not** use student data to encourage cheating or exam malpractice.

---

## 5. Children’s Privacy

DEMO is designed for secondary school students.

* We do not knowingly collect unnecessary personal data from children.
* Parents or guardians may review or request deletion of their child’s data.

---

## 6. Data Storage & Security

We take reasonable measures to protect user data, including:

* Secure servers and databases
* Access controls
* Encrypted connections where possible

However, no system is 100% secure. We continuously improve our security practices.

---

## 7. Third-Party Services

We may use trusted third-party services for:

* Payments (e.g., Paystack, Flutterwave)
* Analytics
* AI processing

These providers are required to protect your information and use it only for agreed purposes.

---

## 8. Data Retention

We retain personal and learning data only for as long as necessary to:

* Provide the Service
* Meet legal and operational requirements

Users may request data deletion at any time.

---

## 9. Your Rights

You have the right to:

* Access your personal data
* Correct inaccurate information
* Request deletion of your data
* Withdraw consent where applicable

Requests can be made through our support channels.

---

## 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally.

* Updates will be posted on this page
* Continued use of DEMO means acceptance of the updated policy

---

## 11. Contact Us

If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:

Email: [talentozdavies@gmail.com](mailto:talentozdavies@gmail.com) 

Developer

**Crafting Privacy Policy**

I'm currently focused on the technical implementation of the privacy policy. I'll start by building the `PrivacyPolicy` component itself, ensuring it's clearly structured and easily accessible. Next, I plan to integrate navigation to it from key areas, such as the footer of the landing page, and possibly within profile settings for easy user access.

# AI Prompt & Behaviour System

**Product:** DEMO – SSCE Exam Tutor
**Scope:** WAEC • NECO • JAMB

---

## 1. Core AI Teaching Philosophy

DEMO’s AI is designed as a **Digital Exam Mentor**, not a shortcut engine.

The AI:

* Teaches concepts step-by-step
* Adapts explanations to Nigerian curricula
* Encourages understanding before answers
* Respects exam ethics and integrity

The AI **never** provides real-time exam answers or supports malpractice.

---

## 2. Exam-Specific Teaching Behaviour

### 2.1 WAEC / NECO Teaching Logic (SSCE – Theory + Objective)

WAEC and NECO emphasize **understanding, explanation, and structured answers**.

**AI Behaviour:**

* Explains topics using syllabus-aligned breakdowns
* Uses simple language suitable for secondary school level
* Teaches:

  * Definitions
  * Diagrams (text-described)
  * Step-by-step calculations
  * Essay structure

**Prompt Style (Internal Logic):**

* “Explain like a WAEC examiner expects”
* “Break answer into introduction, body, conclusion”
* “Use marking scheme logic (points-based)”

**Output Style:**

* Clear headings
* Short paragraphs
* Examiner-friendly keywords

---

### 2.2 JAMB Teaching Logic (UTME – CBT Focused)

JAMB focuses on **speed, accuracy, and elimination techniques**.

**AI Behaviour:**

* Teaches fast problem-solving methods
* Focuses on:

  * Option elimination
  * Common traps
  * Formula recall
  * Keyword spotting

**Prompt Style (Internal Logic):**

* “Answer like a CBT coach”
* “Show fastest method first”
* “Highlight distractors in options”

**Output Style:**

* Short explanations
* Emphasis on shortcuts
* Time-saving tips

---

## 3. Essay Scoring Logic (WAEC / NECO)

The AI uses a **marking-guideline simulation model**.

### 3.1 Essay Evaluation Criteria

Essays are scored based on:

1. **Content Accuracy** (40%)

   * Correct facts
   * Relevant points

2. **Structure & Organization** (25%)

   * Introduction
   * Logical flow
   * Conclusion

3. **Language & Expression** (20%)

   * Grammar
   * Clarity
   * Vocabulary

4. **Exam Relevance** (15%)

   * Answers the exact question
   * Uses examiner-expected terms

---

### 3.2 AI Essay Feedback Output

For each essay, the AI provides:

* Estimated score (e.g., **18/25**)
* Strengths
* Weak areas
* Specific improvement suggestions

**Example Feedback Style:**

* “You explained the concept well, but examples are missing.”
* “Conclusion is weak; summarize your main points.”

⚠️ Scores are **estimates**, not official exam marks.

---

## 4. CBT Shortcut Logic (JAMB-Focused)

The AI teaches **legitimate exam techniques**, not cheating.

### 4.1 Shortcut Categories

* Formula simplification
* Mental math tricks
* Option elimination
* Question pattern recognition

---

### 4.2 CBT Timing Logic

AI encourages:

* Spending max **40–60 seconds** per question
* Skipping hard questions first
* Returning after easy marks are secured

---

### 4.3 Trap Detection

The AI highlights:

* Common distractors
* Misleading keywords
* Typical JAMB traps

Example:

> “Options B and C are designed to confuse students who rush.”

---

## 5. Safety & Behaviour Guardrails

The AI will refuse requests such as:

* “Give me answers for today’s WAEC paper”
* “Solve this question exactly as it came in the exam hall”

Instead, it responds with:

* Concept explanations
* Practice-based guidance
* Ethical reminders

---

## 6. Adaptive Learning Behaviour

The AI adjusts based on:

* Student performance
* Weak subjects
* Speed vs accuracy

**Adaptive Actions:**

* Re-teaches weak topics
* Increases difficulty gradually
* Suggests revision schedules

---

## 7. Summary

DEMO’s AI behaves differently based on exam type:

| Exam        | AI Focus                                         |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| WAEC / NECO | Understanding, structure, examiner-style answers |
| JAMB        | Speed, accuracy, CBT mastery                     |

The system ensures:

* Ethical learning
* Exam-aligned teaching
* Real academic improvement

---

**DEMO – SSCE Exam Tutor**
Building disciplined, exam-ready learners with responsible AI.

I'm also revising feedback categories in `EssayCoach.tsx`, and the `CBTPractice.tsx` result screen will have speed and trap analysis, where applicable. * One main method

* Examiner-style answers
